definitions.gloss: one's go-to song; signature song; favorite song to sing
definitions.explanation: A song that a person always sings, especially at karaoke. Can also refer to a professional singer's signature number.

examples.japanese: ⟦カラオケ→カラオケ：05080_karaoke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{歌|うた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{歌|うた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: His signature song always gets the crowd going.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{歌|うた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一曲|いっきょく}→一曲：30386_ikkyoku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦カラオケ→カラオケ：05080_karaoke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誘|さそ}われた→誘う：01947_sasou⟧とき⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: If you don't have even one go-to song, you'll be at a loss when invited to karaoke.

notes:
USAGE:
Strongly associated with karaoke culture. Also called ⟦{十八番|おはこ}→十八番：10919_ohako⟧ or {十八番|じゅうはちばん}, which means one's specialty or forte, though {持|も}ち{歌|うた} is specifically about songs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {持|も}ち{歌|うた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧ (to sing one's go-to song)
- ⟦カラオケ→カラオケ：05080_karaoke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{歌|うた} (one's karaoke song)
- {持|も}ち{歌|うた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to not have a go-to song)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{十八番|おはこ}→十八番：10919_ohako⟧: one's forte, specialty — broader than just songs
